decisions.decision: Embed the inspection model in a modular application
decisions.context: Each camera must inspect images without network access. The brief does not require independently scaling inference services.

alternatives.label: Model as module in modular monolith

chosen.label: Model as module in modular monolith

decisions.rationale: A local model module supports disconnected inference and keeps the runtime footprint small (d:1, v:1.3).
consequences: Package the model with the camera application.
Update the application when deploying a model.

decisions.decision: Store training images in a shared data store
decisions.context: Weekly retraining needs access to newly labelled images. A shared store provides a straightforward source for the training pipeline.
decisions.rationale: A shared store gives the weekly training workflow a common image source with modest operational overhead (d:2, v:2.1).
consequences: Retention and capacity policies remain to be set.

decisions.context: The brief describes newly labelled images used for weekly retraining, rather than a requirement to train continuously as images arrive.
decisions.rationale: Batch ingestion matches the stated retraining cadence and avoids adding streaming operations without a stated need (d:7, v:7.3).
consequences: Images become available to training at batch boundaries.
Define a reliable batch handoff from labelling.

decisions.decision: Automate model delivery with a CI/CD pipeline
decisions.context: Models are retrained weekly and pushed to devices. Automating the build and delivery steps can reduce recurring manual work for a small team.
decisions.rationale: A pipeline can make weekly releases repeatable; delivery to disconnected devices requires a separate offline distribution mechanism (d:8, v:8.1).
consequences: Maintain pipeline credentials and release configuration.
Prepare signed or otherwise verified model packages for device delivery.

decisions.decision: Keep a rollback path for deployed model versions
decisions.context: A new model is pushed to cameras that may be offline. The deployment choice should allow recovery when a release causes problems.
decisions.rationale: Keeping the prior model available gives operators a recovery option if a pushed version performs poorly (d:10, v:10.2).
consequences: Store the previous package on devices or in the distribution channel.
Define how offline cameras receive rollback instructions.

decisions.decision: Version training data in a data version repository
decisions.context: The team retrains from newly labelled images each week. Linking each model release to the data used for training supports repeatable builds and investigation.
decisions.rationale: Versioning the weekly training inputs helps relate a deployed model to its labelled data, despite the added repository maintenance (d:11, v:11.1).
consequences: Record the data version alongside each model artifact.
Manage storage for retained image versions.

decisions.decision: Trigger retraining on a weekly schedule
decisions.context: The brief specifies weekly retraining, so a scheduled trigger directly matches the requested operating cadence.

alternatives.label: On availability of new training data trigger

decisions.rationale: A weekly schedule follows the explicit requirement and keeps retraining behavior predictable (d:12, v:12.3).
consequences: Handle weeks when new labels are missing or incomplete.
Keep training execution separate from device connectivity.

decisions.decision: Build and validate models in an automated pipeline
decisions.context: Weekly retraining repeats model building, evaluation, and validation. Automating these steps reduces routine work and creates a consistent release input.
decisions.rationale: An automated pipeline can train, evaluate, and validate each weekly candidate before packaging it for delivery (d:18, v:18.1).
consequences: Maintain the training pipeline and its execution environment.

decisions.context: New labels are collected for weekly retraining, and inference must continue on devices without network access. The brief does not call for online updates.
decisions.rationale: Batch learning aligns with weekly labelled data and avoids requiring continuous connectivity or online model updates (d:19, v:19.1).
consequences: Model improvements wait for the next training and delivery cycle.
Training must validate each candidate before device release.
